title: Pre-Operative Assessment Protocol
text: The following results do not automatically stop surgery, but they must be reviewed by the named clinician before clearance:

title: Pre-Operative Assessment Protocol
text: 5.1 HbA1c above 8.5%: review by the treating physician or endocrinologist.
